name: omnidesk-ai-monorepo
description: OmniDesk AI — Enterprise Work Operating System

scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@omnidesk/shared-types run build && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/validation run build && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/config run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/api run build && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@omnidesk/shared-types run typecheck && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/validation run typecheck && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/config run typecheck && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@omnidesk/api run test && npm --workspace=@omnidesk/web run test
